title: The round-2 SUGGESTION about the fixture-shape guard was addressed in the data …
description:
The round-2 SUGGESTION about the fixture-shape guard was addressed in the data but not in the guard: the matrix now does carry double-quoted wrapper rows and backslash-escape rows, yet the US-002 fixture-shape oracle still only counts quotedOk/grepOk/bare/wrapped, so those two new dimensions are unprotected against a future story narrowing them away. Consider extending the shape guard to require at least one double-quoted wrapper row and one backslash-escape row.

Source: cam/issue-388
Review round: 3
